title: Korean Bibimbap
description: A classic Korean dish with mixed vegetables, meat, and a fried egg. The name 'bibimbap' literally means 'mixed rice.'

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as zucchini, carrots, bean sprouts

instructions: Cook white rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tbsp of sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked beef back into the skillet and stir in gochujang and soy sauce.
To assemble the bibimbap, place a scoop of cooked white rice into a bowl.
Add the beef and vegetable mixture on top of the rice.
Drizzle with toasted sesame oil, if using.
Top with a fried egg and garnish with chopped green onions.
